longform.title: The Untold Story of Forgotten Inventions That Changed the World
longform.topic: Documentary highlighting inventions that were groundbreaking in their time but are now largely forgotten.  Focus on the inventors' stories, the impact these inventions had, and why they faded into obscurity. Explore a few specific examples with detailed historical context.
longform.outline: 1. Intro: The concept of forgotten inventions. 2. The Telegraphone (magnetic recording). 3. The Pneumatic Tube System. 4. The Phonautograph (early sound recording). 5. Analysis of why these inventions were forgotten (technological advancements, marketing failures, etc.). 6. Conclusion: The importance of remembering these innovations.
longform.inspired_by: General interest in history and technology documentaries

longform.title: The Great American Infrastructure Crisis: Are We Failing Our Future?
longform.topic: Documentary examining the state of US infrastructure (roads, bridges, water systems, power grid). Highlight specific examples of crumbling infrastructure and the potential consequences. Interview experts on solutions and the political challenges involved.
longform.outline: 1. Intro: Overview of the current state of US infrastructure. 2. Focus on failing bridges and roads. 3. Discuss the outdated water systems and lead contamination issues. 4. Examine the vulnerability of the power grid. 5. Expert interviews: Civil engineers, policy analysts. 6. Potential solutions: Infrastructure bill, new technologies, funding mechanisms. 7. Conclusion: The need for urgent action.
longform.inspired_by: Trend of documentaries examining social and political issues
